params.name: Top bar button
params.tooltip:
How the Stress Test button in the top-left bar looks.
Text: the word "Debug" without a frame. Icon: a gauge icon
on a dark tile, like the game's data layers button.

params.name: No costs
params.tooltip:
On: building and vehicles cost nothing (the game's own
noCosts setting, as in the official No Costs mod). Applied
when the game loads.

params.name: Sandbox mode
params.tooltip:
On: the game's sandbox mode (town editor, industry menus),
as in the official Sandbox mod. Applied when the game loads.

params.name: Vehicles never expire
params.tooltip:
On: no vehicle model goes out of production (as in the
official 'No end year for vehicles' mod).

params.name: No noise and pollution
params.tooltip:
On: vehicles emit no noise or pollution, the game stops
updating the emissions of industries, stations, depots and
warehouses (existing ones keep their current value, new
industries start at zero), and noise and pollution no longer
lower town ratings (towns given their own sensitivity in the
town editor keep it). Applied when the game loads.

params.name: Sim person trip recalculation
params.tooltip:
How often town residents re-pick their destinations (x1 =
game default). Higher = more trips and more simulation load.

params.name: Town development interval
params.tooltip:
How often towns grow. Default = the game's own interval
(60); Fast = 15; Very fast = 5.

params.name: Car traffic
params.tooltip:
Experimental, for testing only. Town buildings no longer
allow walking or lines as a way to travel, so more trips go
by car. Drive: destinations = shops and workplaces; Drive:
all town buildings = homes too. Changes the town buildings
in your save as they are built or rebuilt; after removing the
mod they return to normal only when rebuilt. Applied when
the game loads.

params.name: Town building capacity
params.tooltip:
Experimental, for testing only. Multiplies the residents and
workers of every town building (not the goods it needs), so
more people make more trips. Changes the town buildings in
your save as they are built or rebuilt; after removing the
mod they return to normal only when rebuilt. Applied when
the game loads.

params.name: Show probe tab (developers)
params.tooltip:
On: adds the Probe tab with the in-game experiments the tool
was built from. Each button changes your save. For mod
developers only.
